name: Himuro Inori
source: The protagonist's underclassman, being one year below her. Though he's not particularly studious, his grades are excellent. Inori is related to [URL=https://vndb.org/c1329]Himuro Reiichi[/URL], a teacher at Habataki Academy. Currently, he's into surfing.
